problemStatement.plain: Formalize the connection between Wolstenholme's theorem and Fermat's Last Theorem through regular primes and Bernoulli numbers.
whyMatters: Kummer's criterion was deepest FLT result for 145 years
Bernoulli numbers connect Wolstenholme and FLT

insights: Bernoulli numbers are the common thread: Wolstenholme concerns B_{p-1}, Kummer concerns B_2,...,B_{p-3}
Regular primes satisfy FLT by Kummer (1850), irregular primes need Wiles (1995)
The irregularity index counts how many B_{2k} have p-divisible numerators
